Package io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.api.service

Class ServiceManager

java.lang.Object
io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.api.AbstractManager
io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.api.service.ServiceManager
public class ServiceManager extends AbstractManager
GeoServer OWS Services REST API client.

Covers global and workspace-scoped service settings for WMS, WFS, WCS, and WMTS. The underlying Spring controllers are:

  • Abstract base: src/restconfig/.../org/geoserver/rest/service/ServiceSettingsController.java (defines @GetMapping/@PutMapping/@DeleteMapping)
  • WMS: src/restconfig-wms/.../rest/service/WMSSettingsController.java (@RequestMapping path = "/services/wms")
  • WFS: src/restconfig-wfs/.../rest/service/WFSSettingsController.java (@RequestMapping path = "/services/wfs")
  • WCS: src/restconfig-wcs/.../rest/service/WCSSettingsController.java (@RequestMapping path = "/services/wcs")
  • WMTS: src/restconfig-wmts/.../rest/service/WMTSSettingsController.java (@RequestMapping path = "/services/wmts")

Endpoints covered


 GET    /rest/services/wms/settings
 PUT    /rest/services/wms/settings
 GET    /rest/services/wfs/settings
 PUT    /rest/services/wfs/settings
 GET    /rest/services/wcs/settings
 PUT    /rest/services/wcs/settings
 GET    /rest/services/wmts/settings
 PUT    /rest/services/wmts/settings
 GET    /rest/services/{svc}/workspaces/{ws}/settings
 PUT    /rest/services/{svc}/workspaces/{ws}/settings
 DELETE /rest/services/{svc}/workspaces/{ws}/settings

Usage example


 ServiceManager mgr = client.service();
 ServiceSettings wms = mgr.getWms();
 wms.setEnabled(false);
 mgr.updateWms(wms);
Since:
1.0.0

    • getWorkspaceSettings

      public ServiceSettings getWorkspaceSettings(String svc, String ws)
      Returns workspace-scoped service settings.

      Returns 404 if the workspace does not exist or no workspace-scoped settings are configured for the given service -> ResourceNotFoundException.

      Parameters:
      svc - service type (wms | wfs | wcs | wmts)
      ws - workspace name
      Returns:
      workspace-scoped service settings

    • updateWorkspaceSettings

      public void updateWorkspaceSettings(String svc, String ws, ServiceSettings settings)
      Upserts workspace-scoped service settings (creates if absent, updates if present).

      Prerequisite: workspace-scoped settings must be initialized via the GeoServer Admin UI first. PUT on an uninitialized workspace service causes 500 (GeoServerResponseException). Verified on GeoServer 2.28.2: a non-null gml field on a workspace-scoped WFS PUT does not cause 500 (contrary to earlier notes in this codebase) — the field is simply ignored by GeoServer at this scope. No client-side workaround is needed.

      Parameters:
      svc - service type (wms | wfs | wcs | wmts)
      ws - workspace name
      settings - updated service settings

    • deleteWorkspaceSettings

      public void deleteWorkspaceSettings(String svc, String ws)
      Deletes workspace-scoped service settings. The workspace falls back to global settings.

      Returns 404 if the workspace does not exist or no workspace-scoped settings are configured for the given service -> ResourceNotFoundException.

      Parameters:
      svc - service type (wms | wfs | wcs | wmts)
      ws - workspace name
